text: Starting a new conversation should be done in a new topic for best use of Zulip's topic model
quote: To get the full benefits of Zulip's topic model, when starting a new conversation, you should start a new topic!

text: Subscribing to a channel surfaces its conversations in inbox, recent conversations, combined feed, and sidebar
quote: Subscribing to a channel makes conversations in that channel appear in your inbox, recent conversations, combined feed and left sidebar.

text: Supports advanced search filters like channel, has:image, and keywords combined
quote: channel:design has:image new logo: Search for messages in #design that include an image and contain the keywords new and logo.

text: API provides a framework for building interactive bots that react to messages
quote: Zulip's API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot

text: Provides high quality export tools to migrate between Zulip Cloud and self-hosted servers
quote: Zulip has high quality export tools that can be used to migrate between the hosted Zulip Cloud service and your own servers.

text: Supports importing data from Slack, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Zulip Cloud, or another Zulip server
quote: To import data from Slack, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Zulip Cloud, or another Zulip server, follow the linked instructions.

text: Self-hosting gives you the same software as the hosted Zulip Cloud service
quote: When you self-host Zulip, you get the same software as our Zulip Cloud customers.

text: Offers over 130 native integrations, plus hundreds more via Zapier and IFTTT
quote: Over 130 native integrations. And hundreds more through Zapier and IFTTT.

text: Users can start a new conversation in any channel from anywhere in the app
quote: Zulip lets you start a new conversation in any channel, no matter where you are.

text: Can write and run custom bots, or run existing Zulip bots, via the bot API framework
quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.

text: Full data export includes public data plus private channel and direct messages for consenting members
quote: Public and private data (with consent): Everything in the export of public data, plus all the private channel messages and direct messages that members who have allowed administrators to export their private data can access.

text: SAML authentication, LDAP sync, and advanced roles/permissions are included at no extra cost
quote: Unlike the competition, you don't pay for SAML authentication, LDAP sync, or advanced roles and permissions.

text: Multiple simultaneous conversations can happen in the same channel, each isolated by topic
quote: Lots of conversations can happen in the same channel at the same time, each in its own topic. You never have to worry about interrupting — each conversation has its own space.

text: Search filter to search messages across all public and web-public channels
quote: channels:public: Search messages in all public and web-public channels.

text: Bots can be deployed to a production environment using the Zulip Botserver
quote: Eventually, you’ll probably want to run it in a production environment where it’ll stay up, by deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver.

text: Supports incoming webhooks for posting messages into channels
quote: Incoming webhooks

text: Self-hosted server install process via an installer script with email and hostname setup
quote: Then, run the installer, providing your email address and the public hostname that users will be able to access your server with

text: UI button lets users start a new topic within a channel
quote: Click the start a new topic () button next to the name of the channel where you’d like to start a conversation.

text: Non-guest users can subscribe to any public or web-public channel
quote: Everyone other than guests can subscribe to any public or web-public channel.

text: Offers a wide array of search filters usable alone or combined with keywords
quote: Zulip also offers a wide array of search filters, which can be used on their own, or in combination with keywords.

text: Users can install a self-hosted Zulip server on a system of their choice
quote: install a self-hosted Zulip server on a system of your choice

text: Open to external code contributions via a public contributor guide
quote: Contributing code. Check out our guide for new contributors to get started.
